简介: Sofia Wylie (born January 7, 2004[1]) is an American actress and dancer, known for her role as Buffy Driscoll on the Disney Channel series Andi Mack. Her other roles include Cory Bailey in Australian film Back of the Net and Riri Williams in the Marvel Rising animated franchise. She will star in upcoming Disney Channel short-form web series Shook and Disney+ series High School Musical: The Musical: The Series.
